mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and encourages equity investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in labor market strength (PAYEMS growth) and inflation (CPIAUCSL growth) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS growth * CPIAUCSL growth) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns fail in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 500.0 thousand units) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals supply chain disruptions and reduced corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS > 340000.0 million dollars) reflect strong consumer spending and economic momentum, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 340000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating labor market, prompting aggressive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.
